items.text: CNN's account of Garcia's testimony: he gave $50,000 of the $100,000 to his supervisor. NBC reported $50,000 as the price his boss first wanted, so outlets frame this figure differently.

sources.title: Recap of Diddy trial: hotel security guard says Combs paid $100K in cash for video of assault

items.text: CNN's account of Garcia's testimony: he gave $20,000 of the $100,000 to another security officer.
